about: Campaign mission database. status: built (playable and tested) | planned | outline. Minutes are design targets, not measured playtime.

missions.title: The Last Good Day
missions.summary: Talk with Ylva, find Ragnar at the chopping block.

missions.title: Wood for Winter
missions.summary: Split five logs.

missions.title: The Quiet Foot
missions.summary: Bow lesson, hares, track and stalk a deer; first trait choice.

missions.title: Fire Before Dark
missions.summary: Gather tinder at the old birch and strike a fire; Ragnar hints at his past.

missions.title: Wooden Swords
missions.summary: Strike, block, parry, dodge. The lesson of the blade.

missions.title: Supper
missions.summary: Fishing, neighbours, the Raven Stone; Ylva's question.

missions.title: The Night of Ashes
missions.summary: Longships, the duel, the flight, the gate, a stealth escape.

missions.title: Alone
missions.summary: A blizzard, a draining warmth meter, the first fire alone.

missions.title: The Long White
missions.summary: Cut boughs, mend the lean-to, follow deer tracks in the snow, cook, sleep. Hunger and warmth.

missions.title: Teeth in the Dark
missions.summary: A wolf wants the kill: shoot it or throw it a share.

missions.title: Thin Ice
missions.summary: Trackers in the forest, a river of thin ice, and Bjorn finding a boy in the snow.

missions.title: A Stranger's Hearth
missions.summary: Bjornstead. Tell them your name, or not. Two raven chicks in a fallen nest: name them, feed them. Split wood for Bjorn.

missions.title: The Axe Under the Floor
missions.summary: Bjorn knows the axe. Hide it under the hearthstone. Winter passes.

missions.title: First Flight
missions.summary: Spring. Fly the white raven to find a lost lamb; five omens around the farm seed later weapons. Ten winters pass.

missions.title: Ten Winters
missions.summary: A day on Bjorn's farm at nineteen: plough, feed, mend.

missions.title: Iron and Charcoal
missions.summary: Forge a sickle, then quietly re-haft the old axe.

missions.title: Market Day
missions.summary: Sell the harvest at Kaupang; a rival's son picks a fight.

missions.title: The Boar of Ashwood
missions.summary: Hunt with Freydis; she asks about the scars he will not explain.

missions.title: Harvest Feast
missions.summary: Drinking contest, a wrestling bout, a first dance.

missions.title: Smoke on the Ridge
missions.summary: Scout a column of riders flying the wolf banner.

missions.title: The Farmer's Axe
missions.summary: The raid: farmhouse, fields, barn, burning village. First real fight.

missions.title: What the Dying Say
missions.summary: A raider names Håkon. Stay and endanger the family, or go.

missions.title: The Wolf Remembers
missions.summary: Håkon learns the boy lived and sets a price.

missions.title: A Price on a Name
missions.summary: Bounty hunters in the forest; turn their traps on them.

missions.title: Shield and Scorn
missions.summary: Meet Astrid defending a ford; fight beside her, or over her.

missions.title: The Thing at Borre
missions.summary: Answer a false murder charge before the assembly.

missions.title: Leif's Bad Bargain
missions.summary: Free Leif's ship from a harbour reeve who holds it for debt.

missions.title: Old Scars
missions.summary: Torvald teaches the shield wall and tells half the truth about Ragnar.

missions.title: Knives in the Hall
missions.summary: An assassin among the guests at a wedding feast.

missions.title: The Healer's Road
missions.summary: Bring Ingrid through a plague-struck valley.

missions.title: Why Hrafnvik
missions.summary: Follow the tribute rolls to learn who else was asked the question.

missions.title: Two-Blades
missions.summary: Ulf Two-Blades in a burning boathouse.

missions.title: First Wind
missions.summary: Learn the ship: sail, oars, reading the sky.

missions.title: The Belt Storm
missions.summary: Ride out a storm in the Danish belts.

missions.title: Hedeby
missions.summary: A port of every tongue; buy an ally or a spy.

missions.title: The Sacred Grove
missions.summary: Win a Svear chieftain at Uppsala without profaning the grove.

missions.title: Lindisfarne Tide
missions.summary: A minster on a tidal island: raid it, guard it, or bargain.

missions.title: The Burh at Jorvik
missions.summary: Take a walled town by ladder, gate or treachery.

missions.title: The Iron Circle
missions.summary: Captured letters name the jarls behind Håkon.

missions.title: Hedeby Sound
missions.summary: Torvald's signal fires; the fleet is cut apart.

missions.title: Driftwood
missions.summary: Wash ashore with whoever is left.

missions.title: Ashes Again
missions.summary: The settlement burned in his absence.

missions.title: Those Who Stayed
missions.summary: Gather the scattered: each asks a price.

missions.title: Timber and Trust
missions.summary: Raise the hall, the smithy, the palisade.

missions.title: Grain for Spears
missions.summary: Secure a winter's supply by trade, tribute or theft.

missions.title: The Ring
missions.summary: Ylva's ring surfaces. The truth about Halfdan's line.

missions.title: Three Fords
missions.summary: Take the river crossings that feed Håkon's hall.

missions.title: Ingrid's Counsel
missions.summary: A patient siege or a night assault. One of them costs her life.

missions.title: The Wolf's Hall
missions.summary: Fight through Håkon's hall.

missions.title: Shield-Brothers
missions.summary: Håkon, in three phases, with Ragnar's lesson as the last prompt.

missions.title: What Killing Solves
missions.summary: He names the Circle and dies. Nothing ends.

missions.title: The Captive
missions.summary: Break a captured ally out of a sea-fort.

missions.title: Against the Tide
missions.summary: Hold the settlement against five times its number.

missions.title: Guest-Right
missions.summary: Enter a rival's great hall as a guest and leave with his secrets.

missions.title: Two Clans, One River
missions.summary: End a three-generation feud, or pick a side.

missions.title: Holmgang
missions.summary: Ritual combat on a hide with a jarl's champion.

missions.title: The Long Siege
missions.summary: Direct engines, sappers and a relief ambush.

missions.title: The Oathbreaker
missions.summary: Run Torvald to ground. Kill him, judge him or hear him.

missions.title: The High Seat Question
missions.summary: The jarls ask what he means to be.

missions.title: The Coalition
missions.summary: Sigurd Stonehand gathers every jarl who fears a king.

missions.title: Fire on the Water
missions.summary: Break the blockade.

missions.title: The Pass
missions.summary: Hold the mountain road while the fleet turns.

missions.title: Every Hand
missions.summary: Spend what was built: allies answer according to how they were treated.

missions.title: Stonehand
missions.summary: The last duel, in the ring of standing stones.

missions.title: The Crown
missions.summary: One of four endings.

missions.title: The Old Birch
missions.summary: Family, companions, and what the North remembers.

side_missions.title: Silver in the River
side_missions.premise: Catch trout for the pot.

side_missions.title: Whispers of the Ironwolf
side_missions.premise: Hrolf's rumour about the question Håkon asks.

side_missions.title: The Raven Stone
side_missions.premise: Read Halfdan's stone on the knoll.

side_missions.title: Thyra's Race
side_missions.premise: Foot-race to the well; she cheats.

side_missions.title: The Missing Ewe
side_missions.premise: Follow tracks to a wolf den; kill, drive off or let be.

side_missions.title: Brokk's Last Iron
side_missions.premise: Find bog iron for a smith who will not last the winter.

side_missions.title: The Drowned Bell
side_missions.premise: A church bell lost by raiders lies in the shallows.

side_missions.title: Two Brothers, One Boat
side_missions.premise: Judge an inheritance; both versions are half true.

side_missions.title: The Widow's Field
side_missions.premise: Bring in a harvest before the frost, alone or by rousing neighbours.

side_missions.title: Wolf-Head
side_missions.premise: An outlaw with a price turns out to be wrongly named.

side_missions.title: The White Stag
side_missions.premise: A stag the hunters say is sacred. Shoot it and the village remembers.

side_missions.title: Rune-Carver's Debt
side_missions.premise: Carry a memorial stone commission between feuding families.

side_missions.title: Dice at the Bent Oar
side_missions.premise: Win a ship's share at dice, or catch the weighted die.

side_missions.title: Arm of the North
side_missions.premise: An arm-wrestling ladder with a champion who throws matches.

side_missions.title: Mead and Memory
side_missions.premise: A drinking contest that ends in a rooftop chase.

side_missions.title: The Straight Shaft
side_missions.premise: Archery tournament with wind and moving marks.

side_missions.title: Bearded Luck
side_missions.premise: Axe-throwing for a silver arm-ring.

side_missions.title: The Honest Thief
side_missions.premise: Recover a stolen cargo without the reeve learning who took it.

side_missions.title: Amber Road
side_missions.premise: Run amber to Hedeby ahead of a rival trader.

side_missions.title: The Toll at Limfjord
side_missions.premise: Pay, sneak past or break a chieftain's toll chain.

side_missions.title: A Thrall's Name
side_missions.premise: A thrall claims to be a jarl's son. Buy him, free him or prove it.

side_missions.title: The Bog Offering
side_missions.premise: Weapons surface in a bog; someone is digging them up to sell.

side_missions.title: Saltmarsh Ghosts
side_missions.premise: Lights on the marsh are wreckers, not spirits.

side_missions.title: The Grove Keeper
side_missions.premise: Earn passage through a sacred grove by labour, not silver.

side_missions.title: Nine Nights
side_missions.premise: A man hangs himself in a tree for wisdom; his kin want him cut down.

side_missions.title: The Bear-Shirt
side_missions.premise: A berserker challenges every traveller on the lake ice.

side_missions.title: Iron Under the Lake
side_missions.premise: Dredge lake ore for the first pattern-welded blade.

side_missions.title: Sister's Loom
side_missions.premise: Freydis asks for dye plants from three regions.

side_missions.title: The Runaway Bride
side_missions.premise: A marriage alliance, and a bride who would rather sail.

side_missions.title: Minster Bread
side_missions.premise: Starving farmers ask you to take the monks' grain.

side_missions.title: The Scribe's Eye
side_missions.premise: A monk will write Eirik's saga, if told the truth.

side_missions.title: King's Peace
side_missions.premise: Carry terms between an English ealdorman and a Norse camp.

side_missions.title: The Roman Road
side_missions.premise: Follow a ruined road to a buried hoard.

side_missions.title: Fenland Hunt
side_missions.premise: Wild boar in reed beds where the bow is useless.

side_missions.title: The Hostage
side_missions.premise: Free a child hostage from a burh without bloodshed.

side_missions.title: Whale Road
side_missions.premise: A whale hunt from open boats.

side_missions.title: The Becalmed
side_missions.premise: Five days without wind and a crew that blames the foreigner.

side_missions.title: Storm-Wife
side_missions.premise: A woman on a skerry claims to call weather.

side_missions.title: The Skerry Hoard
side_missions.premise: A riddle on a sword hilt points to an island cairn.

side_missions.title: Hermit of the Gannet Rock
side_missions.premise: An old hirdman who knew Halfdan, and Ylva.

side_missions.title: The Burned Stave
side_missions.premise: A ruined hall with every body facing the door.

side_missions.title: Draugr's Barrow
side_missions.premise: Grave-robbers dress as the dead to keep people away.

side_missions.title: A Horse for a Jarl
side_missions.premise: Break a stallion fit for a gift; or keep it.

side_missions.title: The Short Winter
side_missions.premise: Feed the settlement through a failed harvest.

side_missions.title: Walls or Wharves
side_missions.premise: Spend the timber on defence or trade.

side_missions.title: The Smith's Apprentice
side_missions.premise: Brokk's nephew survived Hrafnvik and wants a forge.

side_missions.title: Astrid's Hall
side_missions.premise: Return with her to the ashes of her home.

side_missions.title: Leif's Last Debt
side_missions.premise: The man Leif owes is his brother.

side_missions.title: Torvald's Shield
side_missions.premise: A training duel that explains, later, everything.

side_missions.title: Ingrid's Oath
side_missions.premise: She will heal anyone; an enemy is brought to her door.

side_missions.title: Things That Wait
side_missions.premise: Find five old things a boy cannot move; each returns as a weapon in a later act.
